selection: all 21 remaining DEV prompts, one hash-ranked MP4 per prompt/generator; 63 natural inputs; no CF
native_sampling: 16 native frames, 8 FPS, 2 s media, 1.875 s observed intervals; no resizing or resampling
repair_estimator: unchanged full-phase 12x12 CoTracker3 + midframe SAM + guarded regional reversal decomposition
origin: original VBench RAFT binary video score; no formula change
mapping: S(I) = I / (I + tau), tau > 0, fit once to make natural calibration mean equal the original Origin mean
mapping_constraints: one scale only; fixed exponent=1; offset=0; zero maps to zero; strictly increasing; no hard threshold or clipping
fit_input: only 63 independent natural DEV videos; neither DEV32 bases nor CF scores enter fitting
deployment: freeze tau, then apply the same mapping to all DEV32 bases, controls, both CF seeds and raw-estimator ablation
acceptance: report actual mean difference and signed CF drift; no refit to make Repair slightly higher or pass the 10% criterion
limitations: numeric score-scale alignment only, not physical unit equivalence, motion truth, noninferiority, or a new independent holdout
